title: iREPA checkpoint migration: lambda=0 one-update state parity (S18) and 2-rank DDP smoke
host: salt13 (2x BW DCU, DTK torch 2.9.0+das, Python 3.11.9, venv restored from salt10 2026-09-03 image)

chain.model: production-shape composite: DenseDiT d=2560 depth 20, 20Q/5KV heads, head_dim 128, BF16; production TextConditioner(16 heads); ConditionTokenEncoder; v4 adds IRepaAlignment(2560) projector LAST
chain.batch: B=1 L=16 M=3 C=8, grid 8x8, T=0.37, T_EPS=0.05, NOISE_OBSERVATION_BOUNDARY=0.95, dropout 0 everywhere
chain.optimizer: hybrid_cmuon_canonical_ns4_fp32_rescue built from the real train_g1_fp32_rescue_r1.toml (base_lr 5e-5, sr_seed 777, canonical NS map, 166 guard bootstrap references)
chain.lambda_anchor: start_successful_update = source_update + 1; weight_for_update(anchor) == 0 exactly (ramp-in starts there)

primary_gate_deterministic_ns.environment: test-only monkeypatch: cmuon_zeroth_power_bf16 -> bit-deterministic FP32 NS + one BF16 rounding at the update boundary (production rescue staging); production code untouched
primary_gate_deterministic_ns.old_model_tensor_comparison: all 287 pre-existing parameters bit-exact (torch.equal) after the one lambda=0 update
primary_gate_deterministic_ns.adamw_state_comparison: all 146 pre-existing AdamW entries: step + exp_avg + exp_avg_sq bit-exact (torchao OptimState8bit compared via block_size/codes/qmap/scale)
primary_gate_deterministic_ns.losses: MAIN JLT per-sample bit-exact; TOTAL == MAIN bit-exact at lambda=0

hcu_leg_production_ns.deterministic_components: bit-exact: MAIN/TOTAL losses, all non-CMuon parameters, all AdamW state, all 141 CMuon momenta, guard references, update counters
hcu_leg_production_ns.ns_affected_cmuon_values: within tolerance: worst relative RMS below PRODUCTION_NS_REL_RMS_TOLERANCE=5e-2; O(1) relative divergence would indicate a checkpoint error and fails loudly
hcu_leg_production_ns.margin: worst measured is ~10x below tolerance; cross-call BF16 addmm non-determinism is ulp-level

ddp_2rank.lambda_zero_parity: bit_exact (primary gate) on BOTH ranks: all 287 pre-existing parameters, 141 CMuon momenta, 146 AdamW entries, guard references, MAIN/TOTAL losses bit-exact per rank (identical comparisons to the single-rank primary gate)
ddp_2rank.cross_rank_note: fp32 rms/max fingerprints of every parameter and CMuon momentum of BOTH arms plus both losses: all_gather_object exact equality across ranks (0 mismatches of 864); invariant_check=True additionally raises on any staged-delta rank spread inside step()
ddp_2rank.bf16_attempts_note: 249 per rank = 498/2: each rank owns half the NS chunks (166 chunks x 3 steps total), owner-rank-computes-once + broadcast
proof_targets: lambda=0 parity per rank (spec-18 comparisons, identical to the single-rank primary gate)
cross-rank bit identity: fp32 rms/max fingerprints of every parameter and CMuon momentum of both arms identical across ranks (all_gather_object exact equality)
invariant_check=True inside step() raises on any staged-delta rank spread
ddp_2rank.note: guard state is world-size stamped (fail-closed): the whole chain (source -> migrate -> resume) runs at world_size=2 so the guard world_size stamps match

hcu_determinism_facts.backend: DTK torch 2.9.0+das on 2x BW DCU (salt13), measured 2026-09-04
hcu_determinism_facts.bf16_addmm: NON-deterministic across calls for identical inputs on every production chunk shape (torch.use_deterministic_algorithms has no effect)
hcu_determinism_facts.implication: the raw BF16-first Newton-Schulz is cross-call non-deterministic on this HCU; production 2-rank G1 is unaffected (owner rank computes each NS once and broadcasts); a single-rank two-arm comparison needs the deterministic NS stand-in for bit exactness (primary gate) and the tolerance leg (spec 17)
